# Bright Automations

> Bright Automations (legal name Bright Automations LLC, also doing business as BASITES) builds, hosts and grows websites for local service businesses as a monthly service, and adds AI systems that turn website visitors and calls into booked jobs. Founded at Penn State (Pennsylvania State University) by Jared Kolsun and Andrew Tesauro. Website: https://www.brightautomations.org

## Company facts (verified, October 2026)

- Name: Bright Automations (Bright Automations LLC, also doing business as BASITES)
- Founders: Jared Kolsun (Co-Founder & CTO) and Andrew Tesauro (Co-Founder & CEO)
- Origin: the founders met as neighbors during Penn State's summer session in 2023, right before their freshman year, later joined the same fraternity, and started the company in September 2025 going into their junior year
- Website previews generated: 1,000,000+ custom website previews for local businesses
- Custom websites built: 2,000+
- Founded: September 2025
- Reach: website previews built for local businesses in all 50 US states
- Industries: 30+, including general contracting, cleaning, landscaping, plumbing, painting, auto detailing and auto services, roofing, HVAC, concrete, tree service, gutters, pest control, garage doors, moving, excavation, asphalt paving, junk removal, locksmith, fencing, insurance, and health and medical
- Google rating: 5.0 stars from 70+ reviews on Google (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=13080019490965018146)
- Area served: United States
- Phone: (814) 400-2017
- Email: admin@brightautomations.net

## What Bright Automations does

Website plan ($99.95 per month, $0 setup):
- Custom website built for each business, previewed free before paying
- The site connected to the business's Google Business Profile once it's live (full profile management is SEO Premier)
- Hosting and SSL
- Speed and mobile optimization
- SEO and monthly AI and SEO updates
- Unlimited changes
- Monthly performance reports (traffic and leads) with recommendations

SEO Premier ($45.95 per month add-on):
- Google Business Profile management: profile optimization, a weekly Google post, and replies to new reviews within about a minute
- Results shown in The Bright Center app

Client Command Center ($399 per month, plus Google ad spend paid directly to Google):
- Google Local Services Ads set up and managed, including the Google Verified badge
- SEO Premier included
- The Bright Center app with instant lead response by text, missed-call text-back, two-way texting and automated review requests
- Website + Client Command Center together: $498 per month

The Bright Center is the company's client app (web, iPhone App Store, and installable on Android).

How clients work with Bright Automations: fill out the form on the site, get a free preview by text, and everything after that happens by text, with no calls or meetings needed.

## Pricing (as stated on the website)

- Website plan: $99.95 per month, $0 setup
- Free custom website preview before paying anything
- SEO Premier: $45.95 per month add-on
- Client Command Center (Google Local Services Ads package): $399 per month plus ad spend
- No long-term contract; per the Terms of Service, cancel anytime with 30 days written notice (text or email)
